evidence.claim: Transaction 3526826 scored risk_score 0.76 on a new desktop device (Windows, Chrome 66.0) via online channel with blank region and generic gmail.com emails.
Two prior transactions on C07671-K2 within 2 hours were in-person in region 310.0 with low risk scores (0.08, 0.03), indicating abrupt channel shift to online from a new device.
Device profile Windows||chrome 66.0 is shared by 8 distinct cards across multiple customers, indicating coordinated activity or fraud ring.
Card C07671-K2 shares 13 different device profiles with 16 other connected cards, confirming extensive web of shared devices.
Similar closed cases for card_not_present_new_device at ~$35 exposure consistently resulted in confirmed_fraud.
Per §6, stop investigating when p >= 0.85 with >=2 independent pieces of evidence.

Per §3a, FILE_REPORT must be accompanied by CREATE_CASE. SAR required if fraud confirmed or strongly suspected (p>=0.7) and activity connects to shared device/another customer's fraud or pattern is coordinated.

case.summary: Transaction 3526826 flagged at risk_score 0.76. Evidence shows abrupt shift from in-person to online channel on a new device shared by 8 cards across multiple customers. Card C07671-K2 shares 13 device profiles with 16 connected cards, indicating coordinated fraud ring activity. Similar historical cases confirmed fraud. Fraud probability assessed at 0.85. Investigation stopped per §6. Case created, card blocked, and SAR filed per §3a due to coordinated pattern and shared device connections.

sar.narrative: Transaction 3526826 ($35.66) on card C07671-K2 for customer C07671 was identified as fraudulent. The transaction occurred online via a new device (Windows||chrome 66.0) immediately following two in-person transactions in region 310.0. Device analysis revealed the device is shared by 8 cards across multiple customers (C13171, C08106, C11891, C07671, C09988, C09933, C11923). Card C07671-K2 shares 13 device profiles with 16 connected cards, indicating a coordinated fraud ring. Historical precedent CC-5106 confirms this card_not_present_new_device pattern results in fraud at similar exposure levels.

stop_reason: §6: fraud_probability 0.85 >= 0.85 with >=2 independent pieces of evidence (new device, shared device ring, abrupt channel shift, historical precedent).
